description: A 4x4 Junon grassland map split in two by a deep ravine running north to south, with a river at the bottom. Two wooden bridges cross it: one on the main road near the centre, one narrow footbridge far to the north. The player starts in a camp on the west side; the village is on the east side, so the only way to reach it is over a bridge.
notes: Ravine: deep (19 m under its lowest bank), 40 m wide, a 12 m floor with a 1.5 m river along it.
Main bridge: field-bridge02, retail's stream bridge, scaled to span the ravine narrowed under it (retail scales 1.5-2.2).
Footbridge: guroomdari, retail's suspension bridge over deep gaps (Anima Lake, Kenji Beach).
'The only way to reach it is over a bridge': a player who falls in climbs out by two gullies, both onto the west bank; the east wall is sealed.
Camp: anima_camp. Village: adventurer_houses (the dry-ground five-house village).
The main road runs from the camp over the main bridge to the village.
name: Mapgen Ravine
